propositions: The runtime contract for how repository-owned code-review project criteria flow through fan-in, Pass-3 routing, eval resolution, and CLI admission must be documented in docs/llm-framework.md with a normative Code-review project criteria section
Project LLM criteria are injected exactly once into round_a and are never injected into round_b; project findings retain their logical criterion id in the project.* namespace
Pass-3 effective routing map governs deterministic threshold, blocking, advisory, and nit-suppression decisions for logical project ids
Project criteria with missing or invalid prompt/eval specifications raise a located configuration error rather than silently falling back
A project code-review id active in exactly one gate resolves and calibrates through the code-review arm of criteria eval; ambiguous or unknown ids are rejected before calibration
